about_the_game:
Aetherial Expanse: Setting Guide

Explore wondrous islands and sail across a sea of starlight floating in the Astral Plane. Inside this module, you'll discover an expansive new 5e-compatible campaign setting filled with character options, naval combat rules, and monsters from across the Aetherial Expanse.

<ul> <li>
Expansive Lore. Extensive information on this high-fantasy Astral Plane setting includes detailed locations, factions,  people of interest, and enough hooks to launch your swashbuckling adventures on the starlight sea.</li>
<li>
Character Options. Over a dozen new subclasses, three new species, and Ghostfire's character heritage system to craft a mix of species and cultural traits to define your character's racial background.</li>
<li>
Naval Rules. Shipbuilding rules to craft vessels that are more than a stat block. Grow your crew's reputation as they navigate across the starlight sea. Naval combat that brings to life chaotic ship-to-ship battles at your game table.</li>
<li>
Mystifying Magic. A treasure trove of spells, magic items, and new magitech crafted from arcane-infused aetherium.</li>
<li>
Monstrous Menagerie. A compilation of creatures and threats to challenge your players as they venture across the expanse's mysterious silver seas.</li>
</ul>
This product was adapted for Fantasy Grounds by Grim Press, on behalf of Ghostfire Gaming.

"
